    int to, cap, flow, cost;
};

vector<Edge> edges;

ll dist[N];
int pred[N], pe[N];
bool inq[N];
ll answer = 0;

int residual(int id) {
    return edges[id].cap - edges[id].flow;
}

    adj[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.push_back({v, capacity, 0, costValue});
    adj[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.push_back({u, 0, 0, -costValue});

    fill(pred, pred + N, -1);
    fill(pe, pe + N, -1);
    fill(inq, inq + N, false);

    dist[SOURCE] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(SOURCE);
    inq[SOURCE] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[u] = false;

        for (int id : adj[u]) {

                pe[v] = id;
                if (!inq[v]) {
                    inq[v] = true;

                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int cur = TARGET; cur != SOURCE; cur = pred[cur]) {
        int id = pe[cur];
        edges[id].flow++;
        edges[id ^ 1].flow--;
    }
    answer += dist[TARGET];

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {

        --x;
        addEdge(SOURCE, x, 1, 0);
    }

        edges.push_back({u, 0, 0, -costValue});

        fill(pred.begin(), pred.end(), -1);

            int id = predEdge[cur];
            edges[id].flow++;
            edges[id ^ 1].flow--;

};
